questions.question_text: A dashboard refetches the same user profile in five child components after every navigation. Explain what is going wrong and how you would fix it.

reference_answer.text: Multiple isolated effects or prop drilling cause duplicate requests. Lift data fetching to a shared cache/provider or use a data library with request deduplication.
